title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in…
description: A reflected Cross-site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in the Custom Post Types and Custom Fields creator – WCK plugin, affecting versions up to 2.4.0. This vulnerability allows improper neutralization of input during web page generation, potentially enabling an attacker to execute arbitrary scripts in the context of the affected web application.
